title: Geometry - Lesson 10 Practice: Geometric Map Construction
description: Practice construction planning, angle relationships, and reasoning for a geometric map with parallel and perpendicular roads.

questions.question: A map has roads $a$ and $b$ with $a \parallel b$. Road $c$ crosses both roads. What is road $c$ called?
questions.explanation: A transversal is a line that intersects two or more lines, such as a road crossing both parallel roads.

questions.question: Which statement should appear on a geometric map if road $d$ crosses road $a$ at right angles?
questions.explanation: The symbol $\perp$ means perpendicular, so $d \perp a$ states that the roads meet at right angles.

questions.question: If two roads are perpendicular, each angle at their intersection measures ______ degrees.
questions.explanation: Perpendicular lines form four right angles, and each right angle measures $90^\circ$.

questions.question: Two parallel roads are cut by a transversal. A corresponding angle to a $58^\circ$ angle has measure:
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles formed by parallel lines are congruent, so the matching angle is also $58^\circ$.

questions.question: In a map diagram, one angle in a linear pair measures $73^\circ$. What is the other angle?
questions.explanation: Linear pairs are supplementary, so the other angle is $180^\circ - 73^\circ = 107^\circ$.

questions.question: Same-side interior angles formed by parallel lines and a transversal are always congruent.
questions.explanation: Same-side interior angles are supplementary. They add to $180^\circ$; they are not usually congruent.

questions.question: A student writes, "The roads look parallel, so my map is correct." What should the student add to make the reasoning stronger?
questions.correctAnswer: The student should state or show how the roads were constructed parallel, then use a relationship such as corresponding angles or equal distance to verify the parallel roads.
questions.explanation: A geometric construction needs evidence. A clear statement, construction mark, or angle relationship is stronger than appearance.

questions.question: In one or two sentences, explain why a perpendicular road is useful in a geometric map construction task.
questions.correctAnswer: A perpendicular road creates right angles, so it gives known $90^\circ$ measures that can anchor the map and support later angle reasoning.
questions.explanation: The important idea is that perpendicular lines give reliable $90^\circ$ angles, which makes the map easier to verify and solve.
